definitions.explanation: The task of washing dishes. Also refers to a person whose job is washing dishes, especially in a restaurant.

examples.japanese: {食事|しょくじ}の{後|あと}は{皿洗|さらあら}いをする。
examples.english: I do the dishes after a meal.

examples.japanese: {皿洗|さらあら}いは{食洗機|しょくせんき}に{任|まか}せている。
examples.english: I leave the dishwashing to the dishwasher.

examples.japanese: {学生|がくせい}の{頃|ころ}、レストランで{皿洗|さらあら}いのアルバイトをしていた。
examples.english: When I was a student, I had a part-time job washing dishes at a restaurant.

notes:
USAGE:
A common everyday word. {皿洗|さらあら}いをする means "to do the dishes" and is the standard casual expression. In restaurant contexts, it can refer to the person who washes dishes (the dishwasher).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皿洗|さらあら}いをする: to do the dishes
- {皿洗|さらあら}い{当番|とうばん}: dish duty
- {皿洗|さらあら}いのバイト: a dish-washing part-time job

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {食器洗|しょっきあら}い: dishwashing (slightly more formal; {食器|しょっき} = tableware)
